summary: Audited main after PR #489 merge. Production remains no-go because PR head checks failed and merge commit has no workflow runs returned yet. Prepared a non-breaking pricing page correction on an audit branch to restore rendered buyer proof, comparison, trust proof and FAQ sections that were present as constants but not rendered.
findings: No open pull requests were found at audit time.
Latest merged pull request is #489, Improve transactional email logging, merge commit 73c4b9f0cc74b0df78fd0372e0df27789f853b63.
The PR #489 head had CI, RISCK COMPLY Security CI and Full Security Suite failures, while Upload Security CI, CodeQL, Semgrep, Gitleaks, Secret Scanning, Dependency Review and P0 gates were green.
The merge commit had no pull-request workflow runs returned by the connector yet.
vercel.json still has one daily cron at /api/internal/daily-maintenance.
Billing checkout remains guarded by authenticated user, organization context, manage_billing permission, trusted mutation/rate limit, step-up, Stripe metadata, audit log and no-store response.
Enterprise demo remains gated by NEXT_PUBLIC_ENABLE_ENTERPRISE_DEMO.
Route health gate documentation still covers public/private routes, locales, /undefined, dead CTAs, controlled errors, RBAC visuals and deployment targets.
Config drift remains: package.json declares @clerk/nextjs but package-lock.json root dependencies still omit @clerk/nextjs. This needs real lockfile regeneration, not manual patching.
actions_taken: Created branch audit/2026-06-26-pricing-regression from merge commit 73c4b9f0cc74b0df78fd0372e0df27789f853b63.
Updated src/app/[locale]/pricing/page.tsx to render existing valueProof, comparisonRows, trustProof and billingFaqs content instead of leaving buyer-facing pricing sections unused.
Recorded this audit as an append-only agent_log.d entry to avoid truncating the large historical agent_log.json file through the connector response limit.
required_next_steps: Open a PR from audit/2026-06-26-pricing-regression to main and let CI run.
Run npm run supply-chain:lockfile or npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts locally/CI to regenerate package-lock.json safely.
Do not release production until main has green CI/security and the lockfile drift is resolved.
